item.title: Pokémon Skateboards Officially Launch, and Scalpers Are Already Buying Them Up
item.description: Oct. 17 marked the release of Santa Cruz skateboard blind bags containing illustrated decks of some of the Pokémon Trading Card Game's best art. Classic cards like the base-set Charizard and more modern cards like the " Moonbreon " from Evolving Skies are randomly packaged in these new products. If that sounds cool to you, here's the bad news: You're probably not going to find any of these in a store.

item.title: Lord of the Rings Director Says He’s Finally Making His Tintin Sequel
item.description: Tintin fans have been in the wilderness for quite some time. After the Steven Spielberg-directed The Adventures of Tintin hit theaters in 2011, Spielberg and producer Peter Jackson confirmed that a sequel was on the way. This follow-up was originally promised for sometime in 2014 or 2015, with Jackson directing. Needless to say, that didn’t happen.

item.title: Where to find penny buns in Enshrouded
item.description: To find penny buns in Enshrouded , you must take a foraging trip to a particular area. Chances are you've already been there but missed these small, brown mushrooms — if there's one crafting ingredient in Enshrouded that's easy to find but even easier to overlook, it's penny buns.

item.title: Xbox Game Pass Is Officially Losing One of the Best Star Wars Games of All Time This Month
item.description: As October comes to a close and leaves fall from the trees, Xbox Game Pass is shedding more titles as a sign that this month is almost up. Xbox has revealed the second wave of titles leaving the subscription service on Oct. 31 (spooky), and while the list may be short, it has some absolute bangers you'll want to check out while you can.

item.title: Avengers Star Officially Clarifies His Huge Doomsday Spoiler
item.description: Ever since Robert Downey Jr. was announced to be playing Doctor Doom in December's Avengers: Doomsday , Marvel fans have wondered how the film would handle this in the context of the multiverse. Would Victor von Doom be a variant of Tony Stark, the character Downey played for over a decade? Would he never take off his mask, meaning Avengers like Steve Rogers and Thor wouldn't have to address how their new enemy suspiciously looks a lot like their old friend?

item.title: Taika Waititi's Star Wars Movie Gets Disappointing Update
item.description: Taika Waititi's newest film Klara and the Sun is out on Friday, but, based on its initial reception ( 25% on Rotten Tomatoes ), its time in the sun may not be long. One Waititi project that may never see the light of day is his long-gestating Star Wars film. Waititi recently gave an update on the movie, telling Inverse it's "on ice."

item.title: Saros' Biggest Update Yet Officially Gets Release Date and Full Details
item.description: The bullet-hell roguelike Saros is getting its first major update. Saros: Zenith brings a host of new features and modes intended to make the game more accessible to newcomers while giving veterans more to do. Best of all, it’s free, and it’s out today.

item.title: Where to find shroud mushrooms in Enshrouded
item.description: Shroud mushrooms are an important crafting resource in Enshrouded , but they're tricky to find. The key is to look up, not down; you won't yield any shroud mushrooms by collecting the cute colorful button mushrooms that spawn in any regular forest. Here's another hint: bring an axe.

item.title: BeamNG.drive Is an Astonishing Driving Sim in Search of a Game
item.description: Over those 11 years, BeamNG.drive has slowly but steadily built up a sizable audience, to the extent that it's currently the second-biggest driving game on Steam , ahead of Forza Horizon 6 and behind the mighty Euro Truck Simulator 2 . I suspect it's going to do pretty well on PS5, too. If you're into car games — and a lot of PlayStation gamers are — you don't have to spend very long on car-game YouTube before BeamNG.drive is invoked, often in pretty breathless terms. The PS5 version of Forza Horizon 6 just got pushed back to January . And PS5 might be the cheapest way to run this demanding, computationally expensive game at decent fidelity.
